         CASE WHEN v.monthly_count = 1 THEN '1'
              WHEN v.monthly_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
              WHEN v.monthly_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
              ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM parsed p
  JOIN volumes v
    ON v.homefirm = p.homefirm
   AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', p.start_date)
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = p.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE p.homefirm = 'COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS US CORP'
    AND p.start_date >= DATE '2023-12-01'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
matches AS (
  SELECT t.filekey, t.headct, rs.rule_id, rs.base_hours, rs.position_hours,
         (rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INT
       + (rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INT
       + (rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INT
       + (rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INT
       + (rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INT
       + (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INT AS specificity
  FROM target t
  JOIN review_schedule rs
    ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = t.visa_class)
   AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = t.wage_level)
   AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = t.h1b_dependent)
   AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = t.soc_major_group)
   AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = t.worksite_state)
   AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = t.monthly_volume_band)
),
chosen AS (
  SELECT *,
         row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY filekey
           ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM matches
),
per_case AS (

)

FROM per_case;

    b.filekey,
    b.headct,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    ((r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*')::INTEGER
     + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*')::INTEGER
     + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*')::INTEGER
     + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*')::INTEGER
     + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*')::INTEGER
     + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*')::INTEGER
    ) AS specificity
  FROM banded b
  JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = b.visacls)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = b.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = b.h1bdep)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = b.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = b.wsstate)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = b.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY filekey
           ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id

target AS (

monthly_cases AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM parsed_cases

      AND start_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS case_volume
    FROM parsed_cases
    WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT mc.filekey, mc.homefirm, mc.headct,
           mc.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
           mc.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
           substr(mc.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
           cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
           CASE
               WHEN mv.case_volume = 1 THEN '1'
               WHEN mv.case_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
               WHEN mv.case_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
               WHEN mv.case_volume >= 15 THEN '15+'
           END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM monthly_cases AS mc
    JOIN monthly_volume AS mv
      ON mv.homefirm = mc.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', mc.start_date)
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite AS cw ON cw.dockkey = mc.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
matching_rules AS (

          + CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND rs.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND rs.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND rs.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM case_attributes AS ca
    JOIN review_schedule AS rs
      ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = '*' OR rs.visa_class = ca.visa_class)

                WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
                WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
                WHEN cv.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
            END AS volume_band
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cb.*,
                COUNT(*) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cb.homefirm, cb.start_month
                ) AS emcv
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.filekey,
                    c.homefirm,
                    c.headct,
                    CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,

                    )::DATE AS start_month,

                LEFT JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw

            ) cb
        ) cv

    LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
        ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)

```sql
          + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

          + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

        r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST

)
```

    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
  FROM cases c
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
cvb AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) AS emcv,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) >= 15 THEN '15+'
    END AS volume_band
  FROM case_values
),
governing AS (
  SELECT
    cvb.filekey,
    cvb.homefirm,
    cvb.start_month,
    cvb.headct,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cvb.filekey
      ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM cvb
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = cvb.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
),
per_case AS (
  SELECT
    homefirm,
    start_month,
    COALESCE(base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS crh
  FROM governing
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  homefirm AS employer_name,
  ROUND(SUM(crh), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM per_case
WHERE start_month = DATE '2023-12-01'
GROUP BY homefirm
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY employer_review_load DESC, employer_name
LIMIT 5;

                           )::DATE AS start_month,
                           cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
                           pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
                    FROM main.cases c
                    LEFT JOIN main.case_worksite cw
                        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
                    LEFT JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw
                        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
                ) cb

           AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
           AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cvb.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST

           PARTITION BY t.filekey
           ORDER BY
             ((r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*')::INTEGER +
              (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*')::INTEGER +
              (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*')::INTEGER +
              (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*')::INTEGER +
              (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*')::INTEGER +
              (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*')::INTEGER) DESC,
             r.rule_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM target t
  JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = t.visacls::VARCHAR)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = t.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = t.h1bdep::VARCHAR)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = substr(t.soccd, 1, 2))
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = t.wsstate)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = t.volume_band)
),
case_hours AS (
  SELECT t.filekey,
         coalesce(rm.base_hours, 3.50) + coalesce(rm.position_hours, 0.50) * t.headct AS crh,
         rm.rule_id
  FROM target t
  LEFT JOIN ranked_matches rm
    ON rm.filekey = t.filekey AND rm.rn = 1
)
SELECT round(
         100.0 * sum(crh) FILTER (WHERE rule_id IS NULL) / sum(crh),
         2
       ) AS default_schedule_percentage
FROM case_hours;

        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM cases AS c

      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'), '[ $,]', '', 'g'),

      ) AS DOUBLE
    ) * CASE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')

        END AS aow,

        '^USD ?', ''
      ) AS DOUBLE
    ) * CASE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw,
    JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'

    AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
```sql
),
```

WITH target AS (

           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from') AS offered_from,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') AS offered_unit,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value') AS prevailing_value,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') AS prevailing_unit,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'

      AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
annualized AS (
    SELECT headct,
           CAST(regexp_replace(offered_from, '[$,]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE) *
             CASE offered_unit
                 WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
             END AS aow,
           CAST(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(prevailing_value, 'USD ', '', 'g'), ',', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE) *
             CASE prevailing_unit
                 WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
             END AS apw,
           CASE wage_level
               WHEN 'I' THEN 25
               WHEN 'II' THEN 50
               WHEN 'III' THEN 75
               WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
               ELSE 50
           END AS level_points
    FROM target
```sql
),

)
```

matches AS (
    SELECT
        a.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (
            CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM case_attrs a
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = a.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR
          (a.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level = a.wage_level))
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR
          (a.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent = a.h1b_dependent))
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR
          r.soc_major_group = a.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR
          r.worksite_state = a.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR
          r.monthly_volume_band = a.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked_matches AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY filekey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM matches
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        a.start_month,
        rm.rule_id,
        COALESCE(rm.base_hours, 3.50) +
            COALESCE(rm.position_hours, 0.50) * a.headct AS crh
    FROM case_attrs a
    LEFT JOIN ranked_matches rm
      ON rm.filekey = a.filekey
     AND rm.rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 *
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN start_month = DATE '2023-12-01' AND rule_id IS NULL
            THEN crh ELSE 0
        END)
    /
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN start_month = DATE '2023-12-01'
            THEN crh ELSE 0
        END),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM case_hours;

WITH wage_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        c.headct,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from') AS offered_from,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') AS offered_unit,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value') AS prevailing_value,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') AS prevailing_unit,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'
      AND date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
),
annualized AS (
    SELECT
        headct,
        wage_level,
        CAST(replace(replace(offered_from, '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) *
            CASE offered_unit
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS aow,
        CAST(replace(replace(prevailing_value, 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) *
            CASE prevailing_unit
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS apw
    FROM wage_inputs
),

            100.0 * least(greatest((aow - apw) / apw, 0.0), 0.40) / 0.40
        ) +
        0.3 * CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
            ELSE 50
        END AS cwas
    FROM annualized
```sql
)
```

        END AS aow,

          + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) DESC,
        r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM cvb
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = cvb.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_crh_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_crh_no
FROM selected
WHERE rn = 1
  AND start_month = DATE '2024-01-01';

WITH december_cases AS (
    SELECT filekey, homefirm
    FROM cases
    WHERE try_strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND try_strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'

    GROUP BY homefirm
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) >= 5
),
case_wage_scores AS (
    SELECT
        dc.homefirm,
        dc.filekey,
        AVG(
            100.0
            * (
                try_cast(
                    regexp_replace(
                        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
                        '[^0-9.]',
                        '',
                        'g'
                    ) AS DOUBLE
                )
                * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')
                    WHEN 'Year' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN 'Month' THEN 12.0
                    WHEN 'Week' THEN 52.0

                try_cast(
                    regexp_replace(
                        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                        '[^0-9.]',
                        '',
                        'g'
                    ) AS DOUBLE
                )
                * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
                    WHEN 'Year' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN 'Month' THEN 12.0
                    WHEN 'Week' THEN 52.0
                    WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080.0
                  END,
                0.0
            )
        ) AS case_score
    FROM december_cases dc
    JOIN case_worksite cw
      ON cw.dockkey = dc.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw
      ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    GROUP BY dc.homefirm, dc.filekey
),
employer_scores AS (
    SELECT
        e.homefirm,
        AVG(cws.case_score) AS score

    JOIN case_wage_scores cws

    GROUP BY e.homefirm
)
SELECT
    homefirm AS employer_name,
    ROUND(score, 2) AS score
FROM employer_scores
ORDER BY score DESC, employer_name
```sql
LIMIT 5;
```

WITH wa AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         (b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw AS whr,
         100 * (b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw AS wdr,
         100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS headroom_points,
         CASE b.wage_level
           WHEN 'I' THEN 25
           WHEN 'II' THEN 50
           WHEN 'III' THEN 75
           WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
           ELSE 50
         END AS level_points,
         0.7 * (
           100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40
         ) + 0.3 * (
           CASE b.wage_level
             WHEN 'I' THEN 25
             WHEN 'II' THEN 50
             WHEN 'III' THEN 75
             WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
             ELSE 50
           END
         ) AS cwas
  FROM (
    SELECT c.filekey,
           c.homefirm,
           c.homezip,
           c.soccd,
           c.headct,
           c.statustag,
           CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
           strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS begin_date,
           date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
           cw.wsstate,
           e.employer_contact_info->>'$.naics_code' AS naics_code,
           pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level,
           CAST(
             replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.from', '$', ''), ',', '')
             AS DOUBLE
           ) * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.unit'
                 WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
               END AS aow,
           CAST(

             AS DOUBLE
           ) * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.unit'
                 WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
               END AS apw
    FROM main.cases c
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    LEFT JOIN main.employer e
      ON e.corphandle = c.homefirm
     AND e.zipref = c.homezip
  ) b
),
employer_scores AS (

         SUM(cwas * headct) / CAST(SUM(headct) AS DOUBLE) AS ewas

WITH june_cases AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) / NULLIF(
            TRY_CAST(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                    '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
                ) AS DOUBLE
            ),
            0
        ) AS ratio
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Google LLC'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-06-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-07-01'
),
score AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) * 100 AS employer_wage_assurance_score
    FROM june_cases
    WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN employer_wage_assurance_score >= 100 THEN 'Above-Prevailing Tier'
        ELSE 'Below-Prevailing Tier'
    END AS tier_name,
    ROUND(employer_wage_assurance_score, 2) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM score;

                    ) AS DOUBLE
                ),
                0
            ) - 1.0
        ) AS headroom_points,
        CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level'
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25.0
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50.0
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75.0
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS level_points
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(0.7 * headroom_points + 0.3 * level_points) AS current_score,
        AVG(0.6 * headroom_points + 0.4 * level_points) AS new_score
    FROM case_points
)
SELECT ROUND(new_score - current_score, 2) AS score_change
FROM scores;

WITH case_wage AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.h1bdep,
        CAST(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        pw.wage_details -> 'offered_wage' ->> 'from' AS offered_text,
        pw.wage_details -> 'offered_wage' ->> 'unit' AS offered_unit,
        pw.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'value' AS prevailing_text,
        pw.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'unit' AS prevailing_unit,
        pw.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
annualized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(replace(replace(offered_text, '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) *
            CASE offered_unit
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS aow,
        CAST(replace(replace(prevailing_text, 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) *
            CASE prevailing_unit
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS apw
    FROM case_wage
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        0.7 * (
            100.0 * least(greatest((aow - apw) / apw, 0.0), 0.40) / 0.40
        ) +
        0.3 * CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
            ELSE 50
        END AS cwas
    FROM annualized
)
SELECT
    round(avg(cwas) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
    round(avg(cwas) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM scored
WHERE start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND start_date < DATE '2024-02-01';

WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.casenum,
         o.buyerlink AS customer,
         substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS month,
         r.revdate,
         c.seg_category,
         r.return_channel,
         p.itemcategory,
         CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS unit_value,
         r.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
         q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition' AS item_condition,
         COUNT(*) OVER (
           PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
         ) AS cmrc
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
  LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
per_return AS (
  SELECT b.casenum,
         b.customer,
         b.revdate,
         b.unit_value,
         COALESCE(arg_min(x.flat_charge, x.rule_id), 15.00) AS flat_charge,
         COALESCE(arg_min(x.charge_pct, x.rule_id), 5.0) AS charge_pct
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules x
    ON (x.customer_segment IS NULL OR x.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR x.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
   AND (x.return_channel IS NULL OR x.return_channel = 'ANY' OR x.return_channel = b.return_channel)
   AND (x.item_category IS NULL OR x.item_category = 'ANY' OR x.item_category = b.itemcategory)
   AND (x.primary_reason IS NULL OR x.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR x.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
   AND (x.item_condition IS NULL OR x.item_condition = 'ANY' OR x.item_condition = b.item_condition)
   AND (x.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR x.min_monthly_returns <= b.cmrc)
   AND (x.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc <= x.max_monthly_returns)
  GROUP BY b.casenum, b.customer, b.revdate, b.unit_value
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(flat_charge + charge_pct / 100.0 * unit_value), 2) AS total_rhc

        b.*,

            SELECT rc.rule_id
            FROM return_charge_rules rc

              AND (rc.return_channel IS NULL OR rc.return_channel = b.return_channel)

              AND (rc.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rc.max_monthly_returns >= b.monthly_returns)
            ORDER BY rc.rule_id
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS matched_rule_id
    FROM return_base b

Using `RevDate` to identify 2025 returns, the average charges are:

| seg_category | avg_rhc |
|---|---:|
| Retail | 80.73 |
| Wholesale | 63.82 |

The charge is calculated as the rule’s flat charge plus its percentage of unit value. For overlapping rules, the query selects the most specific match, breaking ties by lowest `rule_id`; returns without a matching rule are excluded from the average.

```sql
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.buyerlink,
        date_trunc('month', try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE)) AS return_month,
        count(*) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    GROUP BY o.buyerlink, date_trunc('month', try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE))
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        json_extract_string(q.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
        p.unit_value,
        mc.monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    JOIN customers c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    JOIN monthly_counts mc
      ON mc.buyerlink = o.buyerlink
     AND mc.return_month = date_trunc('month', try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE))
    WHERE try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND c.seg_category IN ('Retail', 'Wholesale')
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        b.seg_category,
        b.unit_value,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        (
            (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL AND rr.customer_segment <> 'ANY')::INT +
            (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL AND rr.return_channel <> 'ANY')::INT +
            (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL AND rr.item_category <> 'ANY')::INT +
            (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL AND rr.primary_reason <> 'ANY')::INT +
            (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL AND rr.item_condition <> 'ANY')::INT +
            (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INT
        ) AS specificity
    FROM base b
    JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = 'ANY' OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM matched
)
SELECT
    seg_category,
    round(avg(flat_charge + unit_value * charge_pct / 100.0), 2) AS avg_rhc
FROM chosen
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY seg_category
ORDER BY seg_category;
```

```sql
 FROM (

   FROM main.returns r
   LEFT JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn

   LEFT JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
   LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
 ) b
 LEFT JOIN main.return_charge_rules x
   ON (x.customer_segment IS NULL OR x.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR x.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
  AND (x.return_channel IS NULL OR x.return_channel = 'ANY' OR x.return_channel = b.return_channel)
```

```sql
WITH customer_month_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c.profilenum,
        c.seg_category,
        r.casenum,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        json_extract_string(q.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    JOIN returns r ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00080'
      AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-02'
),
monthly_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM customer_month_returns
),
matched_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.casenum
    FROM customer_month_returns t
    CROSS JOIN monthly_count mc
    JOIN return_charge_rules rc
      ON (rc.customer_segment IS NULL OR rc.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rc.customer_segment = t.seg_category)
     AND (rc.return_channel IS NULL OR rc.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rc.return_channel = t.return_channel)
     AND (rc.item_category IS NULL OR rc.item_category = 'ANY' OR rc.item_category = t.itemcategory)
     AND (rc.primary_reason IS NULL OR rc.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rc.primary_reason = t.primary_reason)
     AND (rc.item_condition IS NULL OR rc.item_condition = 'ANY' OR rc.item_condition = t.item_condition)
     AND (rc.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR mc.n >= rc.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rc.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR mc.n <= rc.max_monthly_returns)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mr.casenum IS NULL) AS unmatched_returns
    FROM customer_month_returns t
    LEFT JOIN matched_returns mr ON mr.casenum = t.casenum
),
ratio AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN total_returns = 0 THEN 0.0
             ELSE unmatched_returns::DOUBLE / total_returns
        END AS clr
    FROM totals
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN clr < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
         WHEN clr < 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
         ELSE 'High'
    END AS leakage_class,
    CAST(ROUND(clr, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS clr
FROM ratio;
```

answer:
Canadian Solar had 5 performance snapshots in July 2019, placing the month in the Moderate volume tier. Using the most-specific matching settlement rule for each snapshot, the total is **$8,677.97 USD**.

```sql
WITH july AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        o.replcost
    FROM plant_record AS pr
    JOIN plants AS p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert AS a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics AS o ON o.snapops = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'
      AND pr.snapts <  TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01'
),
maker_volume AS (
    SELECT makertag, COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count
    FROM july
    GROUP BY makertag
),
target AS (
    SELECT
        j.*,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.snapshot_count = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN mv.snapshot_count <= 5 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM july AS j
    JOIN maker_volume AS mv ON mv.makertag = j.makertag
    WHERE j.makertag = 'Canadian Solar'
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        t.replcost,
        r.rule_id,
        r.vol_tier AS rule_vol_tier,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        (
            CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AND r.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind  IS NOT NULL AND r.pnl_kind  <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.cap_band  IS NOT NULL AND r.cap_band  <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN r.vol_tier  IS NOT NULL AND r.vol_tier  <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM target AS t
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules AS r
      ON (r.maker_tag = t.makertag OR r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag IS NULL)
     AND (r.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind OR r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind IS NULL)
     AND (r.alrt_state = t.alrtstate OR r.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR r.alrt_state IS NULL)
     AND (r.warr_state = t.warrstate OR r.warr_state = 'ALL' OR r.warr_state IS NULL)
     AND (r.cap_band = t.cap_band OR r.cap_band = 'ALL' OR r.cap_band IS NULL)
     AND (r.vol_tier = t.vol_tier OR r.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR r.vol_tier IS NULL)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY snapkey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC,
                     CASE WHEN rule_vol_tier = 'Moderate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
                     rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM matches
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(fixed_fee_usd + replcost * cover_pct / 100.0), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
```

```sql
        om.replcost,
        CASE
```
```sql
            WHEN pl.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN pl.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
```
```sql
            ELSE 'Large'
```
```sql
        END AS cap_band
    FROM plant_record AS pr
    JOIN plants AS pl
        ON pl.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models AS pm
        ON pm.modkey = pl.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert AS a
        ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics AS om
        ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts <  TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
applicable_rules AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        r.vol_tier,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd + s.replcost * r.cover_pct / 100.0
            AS settlement_usd,
        (CASE WHEN r.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS specificity
    FROM snapshot_attributes AS s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules AS r
      ON r.vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
     AND (r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state = 'ALL' OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band = 'ALL' OR r.cap_band = s.cap_band)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY snapkey, vol_tier
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM applicable_rules
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY vol_tier;
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_yields AS (
```

```sql
    FROM snapshot_base
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AND r.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind  IS NOT NULL AND r.pnl_kind  <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND r.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND r.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM tiered s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
```

```sql
WITH base AS (

      WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
      ELSE 'Large'
    END AS cap_band,
    COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,

  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie

    AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
),
vol AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY maker_group, month) AS monthly_volume
  FROM base
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
      WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
  FROM vol
),
settled AS (
  SELECT
    s.month,
    s.vol_tier,
    COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
      + COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0
        * COALESCE(om.replcost, 0.0) AS settlement
  FROM tiered s
  LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = s.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      wr.fixed_fee_usd,
      wr.cover_pct
    FROM warranty_settle_rules wr
    WHERE (wr.maker_tag IS NULL OR wr.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR wr.maker_tag = s.makertag)

      AND (wr.cap_band IS NULL OR wr.cap_band = 'ALL' OR wr.cap_band = s.cap_band)
      AND (wr.vol_tier IS NULL OR wr.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR wr.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
    ORDER BY
      (

        + (wr.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND wr.warr_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        + (wr.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND wr.cap_band <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
```

      WHEN p.cap_mw IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
      WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
      ELSE 'Large'
    END AS cap_band,
    COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
    strftime(pr.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
  WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
    AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
),
vol AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY maker_group, month) AS monthly_volume
  FROM base
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
      WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
  FROM vol
),
settled AS (
  SELECT
    s.month,
    s.vol_tier,
    COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
      + COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0
        * COALESCE(om.replcost, 0.0) AS settlement
  FROM tiered s
  LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = s.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      wr.fixed_fee_usd,
      wr.cover_pct
    FROM warranty_settle_rules wr
    WHERE (wr.maker_tag IS NULL OR wr.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR wr.maker_tag = s.makertag)
      AND (wr.pnl_kind IS NULL OR wr.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR wr.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
      AND (wr.alrt_state IS NULL OR wr.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR wr.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
      AND (wr.warr_state IS NULL OR wr.warr_state = 'ALL' OR wr.warr_state = s.warrstate)
      AND (wr.cap_band IS NULL OR wr.cap_band = 'ALL' OR wr.cap_band = s.cap_band)
      AND (wr.vol_tier IS NULL OR wr.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR wr.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
    ORDER BY
      (
        (wr.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AND wr.maker_tag <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        + (wr.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AND wr.pnl_kind <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        + (wr.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND wr.alrt_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        + (wr.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND wr.warr_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        + (wr.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND wr.cap_band <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        + (wr.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND wr.vol_tier <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
      ) DESC,
      wr.rule_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) r ON TRUE
  WHERE s.makertag = 'JA Solar'
)
SELECT
  month,
  vol_tier,
  ROUND(SUM(settlement), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM settled
GROUP BY month, vol_tier
ORDER BY month;

Using recoverable energy as energy yield multiplied by nonnegative efficiency loss, and classifying a technology-month as Severe when its average efficiency loss is at least 5%, the share is **24.65%**.

```sql
WITH rows_2020 AS (
    SELECT
        pm.pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS month,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.eff_loss_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS loss_pct,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS yield_kwh
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
),
tech_month AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        month,
        AVG(loss_pct) AS avg_loss_pct,
        SUM(yield_kwh * GREATEST(loss_pct, 0) / 100.0) AS recoverable_kwh
    FROM rows_2020
    GROUP BY pnlkind, month
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN avg_loss_pct >= 5 THEN recoverable_kwh ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(recoverable_kwh), 0),
    2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM tech_month;
```

Using recoverable loss = energy yield × soil-loss percentage, I treated technology-months in the lowest and highest quartiles as the **Low** and **Severe** bands, respectively. The results are:

```sql
WITH snapshot_loss AS (
  SELECT
    pr.snapkey,
    date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS snapshot_month,
    pm.pnlkind AS technology,
    TRY_CAST(
      json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh')
      AS DOUBLE
    ) * TRY_CAST(
      json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct')
      AS DOUBLE
    ) / 100.0 AS loss_kwh
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
  WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01 00:00:00'
),
technology_month AS (
  SELECT
    snapshot_month,
    technology,
    AVG(loss_kwh) AS avg_month_loss_kwh
  FROM snapshot_loss
  GROUP BY snapshot_month, technology
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_month_loss_kwh) AS loss_quartile
  FROM technology_month
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    snapshot_month,
    technology,
    CASE
      WHEN loss_quartile = 1 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN loss_quartile = 4 THEN 'Severe'
    END AS loss_band
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  l.loss_band,
  COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
  ROUND(AVG(s.loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM snapshot_loss s
JOIN labeled l USING (snapshot_month, technology)
WHERE l.loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY l.loss_band
ORDER BY CASE l.loss_band WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Severe' THEN 2 END;
```

```sql
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot ->> '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh' AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot ->> '$.energy_yield.availability_pct' AS DOUBLE) AS availability_pct,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot ->> '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct' AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
),
```
```sql
potential AS (
```
```sql
    SELECT *,
        energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS potential_kwh
    FROM snapshot_values
),
monthly_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        month_start,
        100.0 * SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh) / SUM(potential_kwh) AS loss_ratio_pct
    FROM potential
    WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
      AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
      AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY technology, month_start
),

    SELECT
        technology,
        month_start,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_ratio_pct < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN loss_ratio_pct < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN loss_ratio_pct < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
            ELSE 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM monthly_ratio
),
band_results AS (
    SELECT
        bm.loss_band,
        COUNT(p.snapkey) AS snapshots,
        ROUND(AVG(p.potential_kwh - p.energy_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
    FROM banded_months bm
    JOIN potential p
      ON p.technology = bm.technology
     AND p.month_start = bm.month_start
    WHERE p.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND p.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
      AND bm.loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
    GROUP BY bm.loss_band
),
requested_bands AS (
    SELECT 'Severe' AS loss_band
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Low' AS loss_band
)
SELECT
    rb.loss_band,
    COALESCE(br.snapshots, 0) AS snapshots,
    br.avg_loss_kwh
FROM requested_bands rb
LEFT JOIN band_results br USING (loss_band)
ORDER BY CASE rb.loss_band WHEN 'Severe' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
```

```sql
    FROM valid_losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snap_month
),

        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN loss_ratio < 10 THEN 'Moderate'

        END AS loss_band
    FROM technology_month
)
```
